analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free caused by storing raw pointers to elements of decoded->extra_channels() while that vector is still growing. In FinalizeFrameDecoding, the loop at ~1201 does decoded->extra_channels().emplace_back(...) and immediately pushes &decoded->extra_channels().back() into extra_channels. Later emplace_back reallocates the vector, invalidating earlier stored pointers. PrepareBlending then dereferences these stale pointers (ZeroFillPlane/Row path in blending.cc:125), triggering UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered during frame finalization/blending when skip_blending is false and ImageBlender::NeedsBlending(dec_state) is true, with at least enough extra channels that decoded->extra_channels() growth reallocates after pointers were captured. Data flow: fuzzer input -> decode pipeline -> FrameDecoder::Flush -> FinalizeFrameDecoding builds extra_channels pointer vector from decoded->extra_channels() -> PrepareBlending uses invalidated pointers. The provided PoV drives this path and causes read from freed Plane storage.
